R9 SYNTHESIS — THE VERIFY-ONLY COMPLETION (owner delegation 2026-09-07; the 29-feature form kept; no new Part). Fold every row verified this round into the feature untriage-leguin.json ties it to — the record-register set (features 1–5), the relay cures, the dissent and period-scoping rows, the second sources for the single-source limbs — and re-mark every feature that gained a second or third independent voice (the SINGLE SOURCE flags fall only when the new witness is a distinct source, not a distinct claim). Then the r8 critic's §8.3 list: strike 'short' from feature 6's rule; resolve feature 26's rhyme ban against [213]; label feature 1's calendar limb and feature 19's detached author as doctrine or contract, not measured practice; scope feature 11 to the early register and admit the late-style dissent; meet Cummins [635] in feature 5; correct the Coverage paragraph's 'still not reached' list; describe the verbless record syntax [712, 776, 777, 786] wherever features 1 and 21 meet; write the Elfland p. 5 'sentences beginning with And' sentence and the Craig 'taut and clean' sentence as verified rows if this round verified them. Register map: which rules bind the settlement dossier's archivist, which the Herald's pools, which the chronicle line. ADD to the register map the OWNER RULING of 2026-09-07 as it bears on Le Guin's economy rules (features 8, 9, 20): 'only the relevant belongs' governs HOW an entry is written, never WHICH elements of the dossier exist — every element gets its full form because any player may explore any of it; leaving out is a sentence-level art, not a slot-level one. No quotation over twelve words; PARTIAL rows cited only for their supported limb.

R11 SYNTHESIS (the correction tail; the 29-feature form kept; no new Part): (1) THE FINGERPRINT EXISTS — primary/leguin-{all,fiction,nonfiction,nonfiction-written,nonfiction-spoken}.fingerprint.json (lane S6B, 2026-09-06 22:51; PROVENANCE.md appended 22:55). Replace every sentence saying no Le Guin fingerprint exists (Coverage, features 14 and 16, the chair's notes) with the measured figures CITED WITH THEIR SKEW (12,492 words: 9,670 essays/interview answers, 2,822 fiction = Omelas only; no Earthsea, no record register): fiction mean 17.4 words/sentence, sd 13, neighbour variation 0.805 (supports feature 15's 'the optimum is variety'), adverbs 0.16/sentence, semicolons in 8.6 % of sentences, em dashes in 0.6 % of fiction sentences vs 10.3 % of essay sentences; the estate CONTROL already out-semicolons her (0.1325) — say so where feature 26 or any rule would move us toward more semicolons. (2) The three robots-refused hosts (ursulakleguin.com, arts.gov, theguardian.com): 142 of 666 kept rows (21.3 %) read with a browser UA — disclose all three in feature 29 and the Coverage (arts.gov's 18 NEA rows were omitted); leguin1973.txt is provenance-less and specimen-contaminated — withdraw it as a proposed source. (4) Fold the newly verified second sources into their single-source limbs and re-mark every feature that gained a distinct voice (a distinct SOURCE, not a distinct claim): Jameson's world-reduction (a new limb under feature 3 or its own paragraph), Spivack and Erlich for leaving-out, Guynes for exact nouns, Mohanraj for modifiers, Dirda [693] and Burt/Plotz [703] for point of view (feature 19 must quote Dirda's 'confides in the reader' line it currently omits), [650] for sound patterning, Roberts and Steering ch.1 for names, the [462] note for 'no name till late'. (5) Resolve the self-contradictions: feature 12's absolute anti-archaism rule against the same Elfland page's 'a perfect distancer' [803] and 'archaisms are not essential' [805] — state the rule as Le Guin states it (a distancer, used sparingly), not as a ban; feature 12's 'And' limb now VERIFIED via [114]; feature 8's rule against 'Only in lesser matters is realistic detail used' [827] — state both and resolve by register; the OpenAlex stylometry negative no longer reproduces (3 and 2 hits today) — say 'to be read', not 'none'. (6) The verbless-record rule rests on one sentence of her own prose [884] — flag SINGLE. (7) Copyright hygiene: the four kept rows with a finder quote over twelve words ([808], [896], [900], [903]) are cited by index only; the verifier notes holding 63–90-word passages ([739], [787], [741], [731], [732]) are never copied.
